result.instructions: Tools for PagSafe, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a Pix charge for R$ 149.90 for order pedido-1042 and give me the copy and paste code."; "Has transaction tr_8f2c1a been paid yet?"; "Refund transaction tr_8f2c1a.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PagSafe data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pagsafe_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pagsafe_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pagsafe_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pagsafe_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pagsafe_create_pix_charge
tools.title: Create a Pix charge
tools.description: Create a one-time Pix charge. Returns the id, status PENDING, and pix.payload (the copy and paste code to show the buyer). The charge is paid only when the PagSafe webhook reports AUTHORIZED: do not treat the reply as paid. A retry with the same external_id, amount and customer.document returns the same pending Pix within 6 hours (reused: true). Writes a real charge. Uses POST /v2/transactions.

external_id.description: Your order id. On a retry of the same order, send the same external_id, amount and customer.document: PagSafe returns the same pending Pix if it was created within the last 6 hours.

amount.description: Total in reais, decimal, for example 149.9 for R$ 149,90. Never send centavos. Minimum 5.00.

is_physical.description: true for a product that needs delivery.

ip.description: The buyer's real IP address, IPv4 or IPv6. PagSafe uses it for fraud checks.

phone.description: Brazilian phone in international format, for example +5511999999999.

document.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits), digits only, matching document_type.

tracking.description: Optional UTM tags for the sale. They come back in the transaction.

tools.name: pagsafe_get_transaction
tools.title: Get a transaction
tools.description: Get the current status of a transaction created through this API: PENDING, AUTHORIZED (paid), FAILED, REFUNDED, IN_DISPUTE or CHARGEBACK. Use it to check a payment or to recover a lost webhook; prefer the webhook for live updates. Uses GET /v2/transactions/{transaction_id}.

transaction_id.description: The PagSafe transaction id (for example tr_8f2c1a), from the create call.

tools.name: pagsafe_refund_transaction
tools.title: Refund a transaction
tools.description: Refund the full amount of a transaction back to the buyer. The transaction must be AUTHORIZED, created through this API, and have enough balance in every split account. A refund cannot be undone. Uses POST /v2/transactions/{transaction_id}/refund.

transaction_id.description: The PagSafe transaction id (for example tr_8f2c1a), from the create call.

tools.name: pagsafe_create_pix_subscription
tools.title: Create a Pix Automático subscription
tools.description: Create a recurring Pix Automático subscription. Returns status PENDING_AUTHORIZATION and pix.qr_code or pix.payment_link: show one to the buyer, who must authorize it once. After authorization the status becomes ACTIVE and later cycles are charged on their own. For Pix, the cycles are SEMANAL, MENSAL and ANUAL only. If the call fails with HTTP 500, check PagSafe for an existing subscription before you retry. Writes a real subscription. Uses POST /v2/subscriptions.

external_id.description: Your id for this subscription. The retry reuse rule is documented for one-time Pix charges only.

amount.description: Amount charged in every cycle, in reais (not the total). Minimum 5.00.

membership_period.description: Billing cycle: SEMANAL (weekly), MENSAL (monthly) or ANUAL (yearly).

is_physical.description: true for a product that needs delivery.

ip.description: The buyer's real IP address, IPv4 or IPv6. PagSafe uses it for fraud checks.

phone.description: Brazilian phone in international format, for example +5511999999999.

document.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits), digits only, matching document_type.

tools.name: pagsafe_get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Get a subscription's status (PENDING_AUTHORIZATION, ACTIVE, LATE, PAUSED or CANCELED), amount, cycle, and the dates of the last and next charge. Uses GET /v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

subscription_id.description: The PagSafe subscription id (for example sub_5a90c2), from the create call.

tools.name: pagsafe_cancel_pix_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a PagSafe subscription
tools.description: Cancel a PagSafe customer subscription so no further cycles are charged. The buyer keeps access until the cycle already paid ends. This cancels a subscription of YOUR customer, not a UsefulAPI plan. Uses POST /v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel.

subscription_id.description: The PagSafe subscription id (for example sub_5a90c2), from the create call.
